attr.title: retsend
attr.desc: Transfer files between handhelds, phones and PCs over Wi-Fi using the LocalSend (https://localsend.org) protocol — no cables or SSH required. Compatible with the official LocalSend apps, retsend features nearby device discovery, a gamepad-friendly file browser, save routes for sorting ROMs into console folders, and transfer history.

attr.inst: Ready to run. Install LocalSend (localsend.org) on your phone or PC, connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi, and they will find each other.
